    expected = """
NAME
    shadowfinder

SYNOPSIS
    shadowfinder COMMAND

COMMANDS
    COMMAND is one of the following:

     find_sun
       Locate a shadow based on the solar altitude angle and the date and time.

     generate_timezone_grid
       Generate a timezone grid file.
"""

    # WHEN

    # THEN
